instruction: Create exactly one valid closed solid: an axis-aligned block from world (140,-80,35) to (212,-36,53) mm, with one straight circular THROUGH-HOLE of diameter 9 mm. The hole axis is parallel to world Z at world X=161, Y=-63. The hole must be open through BOTH Z=35 and Z=53, with constant radius 4.5 mm throughout. Leave no cutter, construction profile or extra geometry. Use the available RhinoMCP tools and verify the result.
